Senior AI Solutions Engineer

  • Hae paikkaa

Tiivistelmä työpaikkailmoituksesta:

  • You will lead selected AI use cases from discovery to production, building AI agents, copilots, RAG solutions and workflow automations while ensuring security, privacy and responsible-AI controls.
  • The role requires strong software engineering experience with production applications, hands-on use of model APIs, tool calling, permissions-aware retrieval and proficiency in Python plus a stack such as TypeScript, Java or .NET.
  • You will work closely with the Enterprise Architect, AI Platform Engineer and business owners to integrate solutions with enterprise systems, apply governance and use telemetry and user feedback to improve live solutions.
  • The position is based in Helsinki, Tampere or Prague with flexible working, and applications are accepted until 11.10.2026 with further information from Jan Tilles at [email protected].


Tämä tiivistelmä on luotu tekoälyn avulla.

Would you like to build responsible AI solutions that improve how our businesses work? We are now creating a group-level AI capability for Legal, HR, Finance, Communications and ICT. We are looking for a hands on Senior AI Solutions Engineer who can turn business needs into secure, reliable and responsibly governed AI applications and agents used in everyday work

Your role

You will lead selected AI use cases from discovery to production. Working with process owners and experts, you will shape the solution, write production code, integrate it with enterprise systems, evaluate quality and ensure solutions meet Alma's security, privacy and responsible-AI requirements before and after launch.

What you'll get to do

  • Build AI agents, copilots, RAG solutions and workflow automations with appropriate human review.
  • Deliver maintainable applications and integrations across APIs, identity services and cloud environments.
  • Configure agents, tools and related components in environments such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini and Claude.
  • Select and evaluate models based on quality, safety, latency, data handling and cost.
  • Apply responsible-AI, privacy and security requirements throughout the solution lifecycle, with appropriate controls, transparency and human oversight.
  • Use telemetry and user feedback to improve live solutions and create reusable implementation patterns.

What we are looking for

  • Strong software engineering experience and a track record of shipping production applications or services.
  • Hands-on experience with model APIs, tool calling, RAG and permissions-aware retrieval.
  • Proficiency in Python and experience with an application stack such as TypeScript, Java or .NET.
  • Experience developing and troubleshooting in at least one major AI ecosystem.
  • Practical understanding of AI governance, including privacy, security, data handling, model risk, human oversight and responsible enterprise use.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous business needs into simple solutions and explain technical and governance trade-offs clearly.

Useful, but not required

  • Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud, enterprise platforms or more than one AI ecosystem.
  • Knowledge of AI security risks such as prompt injection, data leakage and excessive agency.
  • Familiarity with emerging AI regulation, governance frameworks or assurance practices.
  • Experience leading a technical delivery stream or mentoring developers.

How we work

You will work closely with the Enterprise Architect, the AI Platform Engineer and business owners. You will translate Alma's architecture, cybersecurity, privacy and responsible-AI guardrails into solution-level decisions and evidence. 

Join Alma – where courage grows together 

At Alma, we foster a culture of collaboration, courage and trust, where everyone is accepted for who they are. We challenge ourselves to try new things, experiment, drive innovation and learn from mistakes.  

For us, courage isn’t just about big heroic moves. It’s about the small, everyday moments: voicing your opinion, trying something new, learning from failure, and growing beyond what feels comfortable. 

We promise you: 

💜 Friendly culture where you can be exactly as you are 
We value work-life balance and support your wellbeing with good benefits.  

🌟 A job with purpose and impact 
You get to work with our well-known brands, which are trusted by millions of people every day, especially when they make life’s most important decisions. 

🚀 Growth powered by AI 
You’ll have access to relevant AI-powered tools and continuous learning opportunities that accelerate your professional growth.  

If you’re excited by change and curious about how AI can reshape the way we work, you’ll thrive at Alma. Because at Alma, courage grows together. 

How is it like to work at Alma and what kind of benefits do we offer: https://www.almamedia.fi/tyopaikat/

You will join Group IT and report to the Enterprise Architect leading the group-level AI capability. The role can be based in Helsinki, Tampere or Prague, with flexible ways of working.

Got Interested?

Apply and become part of our growth story! Apply for the position by 11.10.2026. We start interviews already during the application period. We will fill the position as soon as a suitable candidate is found. More information about the task is provided by Jan Tilles, [email protected].

#CourageGrowsTogether
